title: Initialize Distances
description: Set the distance to the source node as 0 and all other nodes as infinity. Create a priority queue containing all unvisited nodes.

title: Select Minimum Distance Node
description: Extract the unvisited node with the smallest tentative distance from the priority queue.

title: Mark as Visited
description: Mark the selected node as visited. Its current distance is now finalized as the shortest path from the source.

title: Relax Neighbors
description: For each unvisited neighbor of the current node, check if going through the current node offers a shorter path. If so, update the neighbor's distance and record the predecessor.

title: Repeat Until All Nodes Visited
description: Continue extracting the minimum distance node and relaxing its neighbors until all reachable nodes are visited or the target node is reached.

title: Reconstruct Shortest Path
description: Using the predecessor information, trace back from the target node to the source to reconstruct the actual shortest path.
